title: Evaluation Metrics Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Safety for Robotics
description: Change the number of trials, successes and violations in a test of an agent and watch the success rate and the violation rate. Then solve six problems about rates, a mean and a range. Used in Chapter 17.

educational.topic: Success rate, violation rate, mean, range and replay testing
learningObjectives: Calculate success rates, violation rates, mean results, ranges and changed-call rates from the results of agent tests, to within 0.1 of the unit shown, in six problems, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Use a formula on new numbers again and again, with the correct value and the working shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Which count is divided by which number of trials?
Why does a high success rate not mean that an agent is safe?
commonMisconceptions: A high success rate means the agent is safe
The range is the average spread
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed answers, each within 0.1 of the correct value; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Successes
controls.range: 0 to 200, step 1, default 26 (never more than the trials)

controls.range: 0 to 200, step 1, default 0 (never more than the trials)

controls.range: a number in the unit shown
